about:
Madden Fabrication was founded in 1992 as a division of a parent company in Portland, Oregon. The shop operates from an 18,000-square-foot facility in the city and serves the industrial, commercial, and residential construction sectors.

The company provides structural, architectural, and ornamental metal fabrication. Capabilities include CNC plasma cutting, multi-process welding (GMAW, FCAW, GTAW, SMAW, SAW), 120-ton and 50-ton ironworkers, programmable draw bending, and in-house AutoCAD and SolidWorks design. All work follows relevant codes and an ASME-guided quality program. The shop handles projects ranging from bridge components and building envelopes to custom metal art, light fixtures, and handrails.

Customers include municipalities, geothermal projects, mills, chemical plants, contractors, designers, and homeowners. Typical projects cover industrial piping, valve assemblies, safety upgrades, facility maintenance, restaurant and retail remodels, multi-family residences, and architectural elements such as canopies, awnings, and signage. Installation is offered within a 100-mile radius of Portland.

Madden Fabrication emphasizes its 30-plus years of experience, advanced equipment, and a team of skilled fabricators and designers. Its stated mission is to build lasting client relationships through precision, innovation, and excellence, backed by a quality program developed under ASME guidelines.
